questions.question: An observational study of 210 participants finds an association between number of practice problems completed and test score. Which conclusion is justified?
options: Number of practice problems completed definitely causes all changes in test score.
The variables are associated in the observed data, but the study alone does not establish that number of practice problems completed causes changes in test score.
Test score cannot be related to number of practice problems completed.
The association proves that no third variable is involved.
questions.explanation: B is correct. An observational association does not by itself establish causation.
